subject: Culture
title: Kumbh Mela
description: A short lesson to help you apply Kumbh Mela.

hook.text: In 2019, 150 million people attended India's Kumbh Mela—the largest human gathering in history.

buildup.text: Held every 12 years at four sacred river sites, Kumbh Mela celebrates the mythic churning of the cosmic ocean.

discovery.text: Pilgrims bathe at the confluence of rivers Ganga, Yamuna, and the mythical Saraswati to wash away rebirths.

twist.text: NASA satellites photographed the 2013 gathering from space. It was visible as a massive human heat signature.

climax.text: Despite the crowds, disease outbreaks are rare. Centuries of crowd management wisdom keep the event safe.

punchline.text: Faith scaled to 150 million still holds together.

quiz.question: How often is the main Kumbh Mela held?
